subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed SKILL.md visibility be satisfied by the open skills lint implementation first, or must normal skills list/check/status/Web surfaces also report failed candidates before this issue can close?
rationale: Current main is still missing the requested diagnostics, and the open implementation PR has proof for a lint surface but leaves the broader product scope unsettled.

options.title: Finish lint-first path
options.body: Treat the open PR as the first core diagnostic surface, fix its review blocker, and keep any broader status/Web diagnostics as explicit follow-up.

options.title: Require full surface coverage
options.body: Ask the implementation to include normal CLI/status/Web failed-candidate visibility before this issue is considered solved.

options.title: Defer the command surface
options.body: Keep the issue open as a product backlog item if maintainers do not want to add a new skills validation command yet.

recommendation.title: Finish lint-first path
recommendation.body: Treat the open PR as the first core diagnostic surface, fix its review blocker, and keep any broader status/Web diagnostics as explicit follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent gateway-backed skills CLI status work makes this the closest current-main ownership signal for deciding how CLI/status diagnostics should fit.
